articles.title: Miasma Worm Hits 73 Microsoft GitHub Repositories in Major Supply Chain Attack
articles.summary: AI agent autonomously discovered 21 zero-days in FFmpeg, while Chrome patches 429 bugs. The machines are finding bugs faster than humans can even pretend to fix them.

articles.title: World Food Programme breach exposes data of 600k vulnerable Gazan families
articles.summary: Another Cisco SD-WAN zero-day under active attack with no patch available. Classic Cisco: creating network vulnerabilities so reliable you could set your watch by them.

articles.title: Internet Age-Gates Are a Growing Global Threat
articles.summary: CISA contractor leaked AWS GovCloud credentials on public GitHub, exposing highly privileged government systems. When the cybersecurity agency can't secure its own keys, we're all fucked.

articles.title: Netherlands Seizes 800 Servers, Arrests 2 for Aiding Cyberattacks
articles.summary: Hackers hijacked Obama's and Space Force accounts by tricking Meta's AI support bot into password resets. Even artificial intelligence falls for social engineering—skynet's gonna be so disappointed.

articles.title: Claude Opus Found a Four-Year-Old Hole in Zcash’s Privacy Layer. Nobody Knows If Someone Already Used It.
articles.summary: Miasma worm infected 73 Microsoft GitHub repositories in massive supply chain attack. Microsoft getting pwned through their own platform is chef's kiss levels of ironic justice.

articles.title: Zcash faces governance concerns after emergency hard fork over critical vulnerability
articles.summary: Claude Opus AI discovered a four-year-old vulnerability in Zcash's privacy layer that could enable undetectable counterfeiting. When AI starts auditing crypto better than humans, maybe we should listen.

articles.title: EFF Testifies to Congress on Protecting Americans’ Rights from Government AI
articles.summary: Trump's unqualified DNI appointment highlights urgent need for Section 702 surveillance reform. Nothing says 'protect civil liberties' like putting a political hack in charge of mass spying.

articles.title: LGBT Q&A Season 1 Recap: Staying Safer Online
articles.summary: Age verification requirements threaten global internet access and privacy. Governments worldwide pushing digital ID gates under the guise of 'protecting children'—oldest authoritarian trick in the book.

articles.title: CISA Adds Actively Exploited SolarWinds Serv-U DoS Flaw to KEV Catalog
articles.summary: Free apps secretly turn smart TVs into web-scraping proxies for AI companies. Your television is now a corporate data mule, and you paid for the privilege.

articles.title: CISA Admin Leaked AWS GovCloud Keys on Github
articles.summary: Canadian authorities arrested 23-year-old 'Dort' for operating Kimwolf IoT botnet that enslaved millions of devices. Script kiddie builds unstoppable DDoS army from toasters and smart fridges—the internet of things becomes internet of pwned.
